Stem bent over: a second straight INK 5 px segment from the same root (0, -4) to the tip (-3, 0) on the water surface. Put a filled FOCUS circle of radius 0.13 at each tip: (0, 1) and (-3, 0). Draw three double-headed GUIDE 2 px dimension arrows. Arrow 1: vertical at x = 0.7 from y = 0 to y = 1; the label 1 in INK has its left edge at (0.95, 0.5). Arrow 3: vertical at x = 0.7 from y = 0 to y = -4; the label ? in INK has its left edge at (0.95, -2). All labels are at least 34 px high on a 1920 px wide canvas. Draw no right-angle mark, no label x, no label x + 1, no point letters, no flowers, no frog, no birds, no lily pads and no weeds.
